purpose: small decrypted PS5 system-application proof target before attempting larger menu components

priority.name: SceSpZeroConf
priority.reason: Repeatedly used by public PS5 tooling as a known-good signed system host/donor process; preferred first proof target because it is narrower than the full shell/menu stack.

priority.name: system media host / PSNOW_EBOOT reference
priority.reason: Public projects use it as a valid signed system media host; useful second target if NPXS40112 is unavailable or too coupled to VSH services.

required_for_gate: at least one executable PT_LOAD segment
non_goal: This does not acquire, decrypt, or redistribute Sony system binaries and does not claim to reproduce the PS5 menu.
